scheme_name: Financial Assistance on Marriage of Sons- Haryana Silicosis Board
other_conditions: The applicant must be suffering from silicosis as confirmed by the Silicosis Diagnosis Board, Haryana
The applicant must be registered with the Haryana Silicosis Board
Assistance is limited to the marriage of up to two sons of the worker only
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹11,000 per worker for the marriage of up to two sons.
documents_required: Certificate of being a widow/widower or nominee (if applicable)
